title: Upstream review gates for optional acceleration and evidence ownership
summary: Review framework policy boundaries, all shared-component consumers, optional backend prerequisites, request-state lifetime, portable reproduction, and independent artifact provenance before promoting an optimization.

software: Diffusion frameworks with optional extensions and singleton model state
conditions: A candidate is being prepared for upstream review

claims.description: A hardware/dtype match does not establish compiler, header, library or collective availability. Keep optional acceleration opt-in, or coordinate one initialization decision across all ranks.

Singleton model state must not extend request prefix-KV lifetime. Use request ownership or weak identity and cleanup on success, error, cancellation and dropped step-mode requests; keep graph buffers separate.
Reusable math belongs in the target common operator layer; model-specific dispatch and approximation policy stay in adapters. Preserve reduction order, casts and dtype/compile/autograd fallbacks.
Tracked source changes remain in the fingerprint even if output directories overlap source. Exclude only the active run untracked artifact directory.
Generated files resolve beneath their own trial; references and duplicate/cross-trial paths cannot substitute for independent outputs. Final integrity or cleanup errors still produce failed records.
Published evidence uses portable paths, complete before/after timings, image checksums and frozen validators. Historical source-pair claims are distinct from rebased-head comparisons.

Framework dispatch and framework tests remain model-neutral. Reuse explicit common configuration; keep model policy in adapters and topology/build prerequisites in the owning backend instead of duplicating model/device/version condition chains.

Shared component or script changes require a direct and transitive consumer inventory, regression evidence for other affected models, and explicit coverage gaps. One model E2E result cannot establish another model quality or performance.

Keep benchmark code and acceptance criteria outside the candidate optimization change. Pin the same independently reviewed evaluator for both arms; archive historical results without treating them as validation of a later revision.

Prefer full-model E2E coverage for normal model behavior. Add focused tests for cache invalidation, errors, fallback selection and shared consumers only where E2E does not exercise the contract; avoid repeated production-shape matrices.

Prefer module-level imports for ordinary dependencies; retain documented lazy imports where transitive optional kernels or backend libraries would otherwise become unconditional platform requirements.

Share identical kernel eligibility predicates across consumers. Colocate small ownership-only types with their consumer instead of adding modules for speculative growth. Explain low-precision round trips that reproduce eager intermediate rounding.

recommendations: Demonstrate each correctness issue with existing E2E coverage or a focused regression for a boundary the E2E suite does not exercise.
Use a benchmark and quality evaluator reviewed and frozen independently of the candidate optimization; changes to the evaluator require a separate review and campaign.
Publish complete campaign archives and hash manifests, while preserving legacy records.
Remove obsolete selection knobs and their model-specific framework tests when consolidating configuration.
Attach a consumer-to-test coverage map, including fast/fallback paths, layouts, dtypes, hooks, gradients and applicable encoder/decoder integration.
validation_plan: Exercise unavailable-extension default selection without CUDA.
Drop a populated request cache and check weak references after success/error/interrupt and step-mode cancellation.
Run all consumers of moved shared operators, including their numeric CUDA contracts.
Reject output aliasing and source changes under overlapping output roots.
Re-run native full-service quality and comparable current-base/current-head measurements after rebase.
Verify default dispatch does not load optional extensions and explicit common settings reach the selected backend without model or device-name predicates.
Record source/environment/test commands and all skips or failures for every affected consumer; mark missing coverage INCONCLUSIVE rather than generalizing target-model E2E evidence.
Verify that the candidate diff cannot edit its scoring benchmark or frozen quality criteria.
Map added tests to failure modes missing from existing E2E coverage and remove duplicated successful-path checks.
Exercise imports with optional backend modules unavailable; preserve eager intermediate roundings and dropped-request weak-reference cleanup when consolidating helpers or ownership types.
limitations: This record imports review guidance; it is not a benchmark or an accelerator support claim.
Local regression and E2E results belong to the review-response report and its pinned evidence, not this portable record.
